title: Michael confirms the UFO in the first phone call
place_text: November 5 missile site, Ellsworth AFB, South Dakota

tellings.quote: It was It was big though. I remember. We saw it. It was It was white.

plain: Michael Johnson, an Air Force veteran, says that in 1977 he was at a nuclear missile site called November 5, part of Ellsworth Air Force Base in South Dakota, when he and a fellow airman named Mario Woods saw a UFO. He says that when the two reconnected by phone in 2026, after about fifty years, he confirmed it: "It was big though. We saw it. It was white." He tells it because, if true, two witnesses separately remember the same object at a nuclear site.
